release_notes:
FocusDefend v3.8.3 (Build 76): Native Heads-Up Push Notification Engine & React Hook Stability.
• React Hook Rule Resolution: Completely resolved 'Rendered fewer hooks than expected' crash caused by premature early return in floating navigation.
• Native Heads-Up Push Engine: Redesigned Android notification architecture with high-priority heads-up banners, dedicated sound, vibration patterns, and action buttons.
• Interactive Push Composer: Added built-in notification composer form with custom titles, messages, category channels, and delivery timing.
• Android 14 Compatibility: Safe channel creation and removal of restricted fullScreenIntent barriers for seamless system-tray push delivery.
